Any item, if required at the time of service e xecution is in Contractor scope. 4. Quote should be valid as per GeM bid. Contractor may inspect the site before p articipation. 5. All materials are to be entered at BDL Bhanur-CISF Gate. 6. The Engineers-in-charge for the subject work is Mr. Puneet Kumar Singh Mgr (PE D) & Site-in-charge is Mr. Veera Kumar M, CE (PED-Elect).

7. This work cost includes packaging, freight, transport, insurance, fixing, testing & calibration etc. 8. Vendor may be called for Price Negotiation if required. 9. Safety Terms: While working on site, your personnel should follow all safety pr ecautions with PPEs & any hindrance in the working area at BDL is not responsi ble for any accidents to your service personnel. Insurance & all other incidents a re in your scope to the extent of his liability under workmen’s compensation AC T 1923 & others. BDL is not responsible for any direct or indirect accidents to yo ur service personnel. Vendor has to arrange all the necessary safety devices lik e Helmets, Safety Shoes etc. for carrying out the entire work. II. PAYMENT TERMS: 1. 100% Payment will be made within 30 days after receiving certificate from Site- in-charge and Engineer-in-charge with endorsement by the user about satisfact ory work completion and submission of the following documents: a. Original GEM Invoice and GST invoice with three copies. L.D.Clause: If the Seller fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Services within the ori ginal/re-fixed delivery time-period(s) specified in the Contract, BDL reserves the right to deduct/rec over from the seller, the Liquidated Damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure co nditions afore- said, @ 0.5% per week or part of the week of delayed period as pre estimated damag es not exceeding 10% of the contract value without any controversy/dispute of any sort whatsoever. 2. BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is r eflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law. 3. Invoice should contain GeM contract no, contract period, Description & Rates as per Contract order. 4. Statutory deductions as applicable will be deducted while releasing the pay ment. III. SPECIAL CONDITIONS: 1. The contractor / Agency have to abide by the rules prevailing in BDL. The contra ctor / Agency has to be engage skilled personal having required certificate.

2. The contractor shall possess and submit copy of valid ‘A/B’ Grade Electrical Lice nse, G.S.T /, P.F Code No., IT PAN, GST & ESI Registration No. 3. The tenders shall abide all the labour laws the state and the central government s in force. Contractor shall be responsible for all the consequence arising out of non-adherence by him of these to laws. Contractor shall be responsible for pay ment of compensation to his workmen employed on the job in case of accident. 4. Contractor / Agency have to make his own arrangements for accommodation fo r his workmen. 5. The contractor / Agency have to follow BDL security rules. 6. The contractor / Agency shall be responsible for execution of work safely. Safet y of machinery, personnel working shall also the part of contractor’s responsibili ty. 7. The contractor / Agency shall make his own arrangements for all the material, t ools, Ladder,tackles and labor required for the work. Premises to be cleaned aft er completion of the work. 8. Contractor / Agency requested to inspect the site thoroughly before quoting for each item in the tender schedule. 9. Sample of all the materials shall be approved by the BDL before use. 10. All debris material generated should be disposed within the factory premises (S crap yard) or as directed by E.I.C. Scrap Depot Challan to be filled and submitte d. 11. The works should be executed without disturb / damaging the existing water lin e, electrical / Tele Phone cables. If it gets damaged during execution of work, sa me has to be repair/replace the items of water pipe/Electric cable etc., on their own cost. Otherwise equivalent repair cost amount will be deducted from their f inal bill. Roads have to be maintained as it is before the execution/ road cutting & filling by proper required road material. Road pieces /cracks are not considere d. 12. Material brought for work must be entered in CISF / BDL security register. 13. Contractor has to make his own arrangement for lighting if required. 14. No material will be issued by BDL. 15. Contractors are required to comply with the provisions of ESI & PF act. 16. Contractor has to take the insurance for the workers engaged for the work. 17. As BDL is ISO-14001:2004 (EMS) certified company; contractors are requested t o follow the EMS norms. 18. All the accessories like nut, bolts, clamps any other accessories material require d for fixing of water heater / other items is in the contractor’s scope.

19. The works shall be completed as a whole, Partial value/completion is not consid ered. 20. Contractor has to take necessary pass for their men from security personnel. En gaged workmen have to be wear Safety jacket along with Identity card for Ident ification. Contractor has to maintain necessary record/register for details of thei r men and their Entry/Exit to BDL Premises during execution and the same to b e submitted along with Invoice. IV. ELEGIBILITY CRITERIA: 1. The bidder has to submit the proof of experience of having successfully complet ed similar works in CPWD, MES, P&T, Railways, Defence and other Govt. Depart ment, state PWD, CSIR or any of its laboratories, reputed Private sector and join t venture with multinational companies, during last 7 years ending 31st March 2 026. 2. In case of experience certificate obtained from reputed organizations the same shall be supported with TDS certificate by the contractor. 3. Similar work means: Internal Electrification/ External Electrification 4. Availability of office of service provider: An office of the service provider must b e located in the state of consignee. Documentary evidence to be submitted .
